answer: The pigment index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the marble queue while honest agents promoted earlier goes on earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1237 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the basalt. The bill scales 25 fold, not the vote. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
